field_values_planned_hire_note_index.name: field_values_planned_hire_note_index
field_values_planned_hire_note_index.where: "fathom"."field_values"."planned_hire_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fathom"."field_values"."note" IS NOT NULL

field_values_planned_hire_number_index.name: field_values_planned_hire_number_index

field_values_feature_note_index.name: field_values_feature_note_index

fields_type_settings.name: fields_type_settings
fields_type_settings.value: ("fathom"."fields"."type" = 'choice' AND "fathom"."fields"."list_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fathom"."fields"."visibility" IS NULL) OR ("fathom"."fields"."type" IN ('link', 'note', 'number') AND "fathom"."fields"."list_id" IS NULL AND "fathom"."fields"."visibility" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "fathom"."fields"."multiple")

people_dates_in_order.name: people_dates_in_order
people_dates_in_order.value: "fathom"."people"."end_date" IS NULL OR "fathom"."people"."start_date" IS NULL OR "fathom"."people"."end_date" >= "fathom"."people"."start_date"

planning_settings_ramp_up_percents.name: planning_settings_ramp_up_percents
planning_settings_ramp_up_percents.value: array_ndims("fathom"."planning_settings"."ramp_up_percents") = 1 AND array_position("fathom"."planning_settings"."ramp_up_percents", NULL) IS NULL AND cardinality("fathom"."planning_settings"."ramp_up_percents") <= 12 AND 1 <= ALL("fathom"."planning_settings"."ramp_up_percents") AND 100 >= ALL("fathom"."planning_settings"."ramp_up_percents")
